events.title: Demo update v1.2
events.summary: Demo v1.2 is Live!New StuffAdded more reaction linesCharacters now comment when flee battle and victory3 lines per character and a special line when scan and fleeNew throwing item4 items can throw in battle with limited amount, and one hit player too (be careful)AnimationsEach character now uses second hit animation when take heavy damage, make hits look strongerQuality of lifeAdjusted some enemy behavior

events.title: Demo Update v1.1 – Patch Notes
events.summary: Thanks for trying the demo! Here’s what we’ve been messing with this week.New StuffAdded new character reaction linesCharacters now comment when taking light damage, heavy damage, death, and when getting revived.Each character has 3 lines per situation, randomized so it shouldn’t feel too spammy.Added skill feedbackDebuff and negative status-only skill now display grey flash instead of emptiness.Bug FixesFixed healing item that heals more than it should be.Fixed a bug where game freeze sometime

events.title: Almost a year in the making… and finally on Steam!
events.summary: This is my very first post here. I’ve been working on this little project for almost a year—late nights, too much coffee, and way too many “why is this bug still here??” moments.The game isn’t finished yet (far from it, honestly), but I’m super excited to finally have a Steam page live!It’s a turn-based RPG with a twist: the world reacts to your actions in ways you might not expect.
